title: Yangxinshi Tablet protects against post-myocardial infarction heart failure with reduced ejection fraction by improving energy metabolism through inhibition of FOXO1/PDK4 signaling.
authors: Guo, Jingwen; Miao, Rong; Fan, Qingying; Li, Yilin; Tian, Yuhua; Sun, Aomei; Zhang, Qingrui; Lv, Zhenguo; Qi, Guangwei; Francis, Opoku Bonsu; Liu, Rui; Chen, Ting; Liu, Qin; Li, Ruiqiao; He, Jun; Sun, Yan; Leng, Ling; Jiang, Miaomiao; Wang, Qilong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究养心氏片通过抑制FOXO1/PDK4信号改善心梗后心衰的能量代谢，虽涉及转录因子FOXO1但核心是药物机制与代谢，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Heart failure (HF) is a major contributor to global morbidity and mortality, with myocardial infarction (MI)-induced HF accounting for a substantial proportion of cases. Although Yangxinshi Tablet (YXS) is clinically used, the mechanisms by which it alleviates HF remain unclear. To elucidate the protective mechanisms of YXS in post-MI HF. An MI-induced HF model was established in male Sprague-Dawley rats, and cardiac function, exercise endurance, hemodynamics, serum biochemical indices, and pathological damage were assessed. To investigate the underlying mechanisms, metabolomics, quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR), ribonucleic acid sequencing (RNA-seq), Western blot, immunofluorescence, chromatin-immunoprecipitation (ChIP)-qPCR, and single-cell RNA-seq were employed. The components of YXS were analyzed via molecular docking, and their biological activity was validated in cell-based assays. YXS improved cardiac function and exercise endurance, enhanced hemodynamic parameters, reduced inflammatory cell infiltration, and decreased collagen fiber deposition in vivo. In vitro, YXS regulated mitochondrial energy metabolism and protected against oxygen-glucose deprivation (OGD)-induced cardiomyocyte injury. Notably, YXS ameliorated post-MI HF by inhibiting forkhead box O1 (FOXO1)/pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase 4 (PDK4) signaling, thereby promoting the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle and increasing adenosine 5'-triphosphate (ATP) levels to restore energy metabolism both in vivo and in vitro. Senkyunolide H, apigenin, astragaloside IV, and astragaloside VII were identified as active constituents of YXS using an OGD-induced H9c2 cell injury model. These findings indicate that YXS exerts cardioprotective effects in a rat model of post-MI HF. Mechanistically, YXS inhibits FOXO1/PDK4 signaling, enhances TCA cycle activity, and elevates ATP production to improve cardiac energy metabolism and restore energy homeostasis.
abstract_zh: 心力衰竭（HF）是全球发病率和死亡率的主要贡献因素，其中由心肌梗死（MI）诱导的心力衰竭占相当比例。尽管养心氏片（YXS）在临床上被使用，但其缓解心力衰竭的机制仍不清楚。旨在阐明YXS在心肌梗死后心力衰竭中的保护机制。在雄性Sprague-Dawley大鼠中建立了MI诱导的心力衰竭模型，并评估了心脏功能、运动耐力、血流动力学、血清生化指标及病理损伤。为探究潜在机制，采用了代谢组学、定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）、核糖核酸测序（RNA-seq）、蛋白质印迹、免疫荧光、染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）-qPCR及单细胞RNA-seq。通过分子对接分析了YXS的成分，并在细胞实验中验证了其生物活性。YXS在体内改善了心脏功能和运动耐力，增强了血流动力学参数，减少了炎症细胞浸润，并降低了胶原纤维沉积。在体外，YXS调节线粒体能量代谢，并保护心肌细胞免受氧糖剥夺（OGD）诱导的损伤。值得注意的是，YXS通过抑制叉头框蛋白O1（FOXO1）/丙酮酸脱氢酶激酶4（PDK4）信号通路，从而促进三羧酸（TCA）循环并增加腺苷5'-三磷酸（ATP）水平，在体内和体外均恢复了能量代谢。利用OGD诱导的H9c2细胞损伤模型，鉴定出洋川芎内酯H、芹菜素、黄芪甲苷IV和黄芪甲苷VII为YXS的活性成分。这些发现表明，YXS在MI后心力衰竭大鼠模型中发挥心脏保护作用。机制上，YXS抑制FOXO1/PDK4信号通路，增强TCA循环活性，并提高ATP生成，以改善心脏能量代谢并恢复能量稳态。
